metadata.summary: Third slice of job_agent batch 8: knowledge providers (knowledge.py), optional LLM narrative + call log (llm.py, llm_log.py), deterministic mapping layer (mapping.py), positioning (positioning.py, positioning_plan.py), career profile (profile.py), CV evidence reconciliation (reconcile.py). Cross-file edges grounded in verified imports.

nodes.name: job_agent/job_agent/career/knowledge.py
nodes.description: Read-only career knowledge sources behind the CareerKnowledge seam. NullCareerKnowledge serves nothing (default); PersonalAiCareerKnowledge lazily opens read-only (?mode=ro) connections to the parent personal_ai SQLite DB and maps hits to DOCUMENTED evidence. Failed provider degrades to an explicit unavailable state.

nodes.name: CareerKnowledgeUnavailable
nodes.description: Raised only when a configured provider is present but unusable.

nodes.name: CareerKnowledge
nodes.description: Protocol: health(), memory_search(), corpus_search().

nodes.name: NullCareerKnowledge
nodes.description: Provider serving nothing; health() always False (offline default).

nodes.name: PersonalAiCareerKnowledge
nodes.description: Lazy, strictly read-only adapter over the parent personal_ai DB via sqlite ?mode=ro; imports parent store/retriever lazily, never at import time.

nodes.name: build_knowledge
nodes.description: Construct the provider named by provider (none / personal_ai), raising CareerKnowledgeUnavailable when a configured provider fails to build.

nodes.name: job_agent/job_agent/career/llm.py
nodes.description: Optional LLM career-fit narrative. LLM is a proposal generator only: output validated against a pydantic schema + evidence allow-list; failure degrades to None. Also provides the semantic-mapping classification backend (classify_mapping).

nodes.name: CareerLlmError
nodes.description: The LLM produced unusable output (counted, never logged with content).

nodes.name: FitNarrative
nodes.description: Validated, length-capped, evidence-allow-listed narrative output.

nodes.name: CareerLlmClient
nodes.description: Protocol for any narrative backend; failures surface as None.

nodes.name: OllamaJsonClient
nodes.description: Ollama-backed client posting a JSON-schema format contract with think:false (fix for reasoning models emitting empty content), retries, and aggregate-only call logging.

nodes.name: parse_narrative
nodes.description: Parse + validate model narrative against schema + allow-list; out-of-allowlist ids dropped; malformed output returns None.

nodes.name: job_agent/job_agent/career/llm_log.py
nodes.description: Aggregate-only LLM call observability: operational metadata per call (type, model, duration, outcome, retry_count), never prompts or personal content.

nodes.name: LlmOutcome
nodes.description: Per-call outcome enum: success / schema_invalid / timeout / http_error / transport_error.

nodes.name: LlmCallRecord
nodes.description: Frozen operational record for one LLM call; content never stored.

nodes.name: LlmCallLog
nodes.description: Bounded call log (default cap 256) with aggregate outcome counts and duration totals.

nodes.name: job_agent/job_agent/career/mapping.py
nodes.description: Deterministic requirement-capability-evidence mapping with explicit coverage (STRONG/PARTIAL/TRANSFERABLE/GAP/UNKNOWN), confidence, evidence ids, and explicit negative-evidence flag. Negative evidence is never confused with no evidence.

nodes.name: CoverageLevel
nodes.description: Coverage enum: STRONG, PARTIAL, TRANSFERABLE, GAP, UNKNOWN.

nodes.name: RequirementMap
nodes.description: One requirement-capability mapping: coverage, confidence, evidence ids, negative flag, layer (deterministic/semantic), reasoning.

nodes.name: _concept_haystack
nodes.description: Join claim, keywords, categories into a searchable haystack.

nodes.name: _has_concept_hint
nodes.description: True when evidence claim/keywords carry a concept synonym (required for narrow adjacent concepts).

nodes.name: adjacent_evidence
nodes.description: Deterministic adjacency lookup for a concept; shared by mapping and fit so the two consumer views never disagree.

nodes.name: _is_negative
nodes.description: Concept-aware negative-evidence detection (generic + per-concept negation patterns).

nodes.name: _direct_hits
nodes.description: Evidence whose haystack matches the concept keyword terms.

nodes.name: _best_level
nodes.description: Highest trust level among hits.

nodes.name: _confidence_for
nodes.description: Confidence from trust level + evidence count; negative evidence pinned low.

nodes.name: map_requirements
nodes.description: Build the requirement-capability map for a job's bounded concept set. Deterministic and stable; role-family structural requirement maps against targets without evidence.

nodes.name: _profile_is_sparse
nodes.description: Empty/near-empty profile forces UNKNOWN rather than GAP for un-evidenced concepts.

nodes.name: job_agent/job_agent/career/positioning.py
nodes.description: Deterministic, evidence-grounded positioning recommendations for a job fit. Nothing claimed beyond the evidence window; advisory only.

nodes.name: build_positioning
nodes.description: Return a small, deterministic set of honest positioning suggestions from attrs, career, strengths, coverage, and evidence.

nodes.name: job_agent/job_agent/career/positioning_plan.py
nodes.description: Structured, deterministic positioning plan for a job-specific CV proposal. Reorganises/selects/summarises the user's own evidence, never adds facts; every list carries its evidence ids.

nodes.name: PositioningPlan
nodes.description: Plan aggregate: headline, themes, emphasized experience, achievements, skills, de-emphases, risks, gaps, evidence refs.

nodes.name: _supported
nodes.description: True when mapping coverage is a supported (non-GAP) level.

nodes.name: build_positioning_plan
nodes.description: Deterministic plan from career, mapping list, and evidence; surfaces GAP/negative concepts explicitly.

nodes.name: truncate
nodes.description: Cap a string at limit chars with an ellipsis.

nodes.name: _build_headline
nodes.description: Headline from target role families + top documented capability.

nodes.name: _transition_narrative
nodes.description: Narrative text when current role family differs from targets.

nodes.name: job_agent/job_agent/career/profile.py
nodes.description: Career profile: structured, provenance-typed view of the user's trajectory. derive_career_profile is deterministic and conservative: explicit fields are verified, inferred fields recorded and never treated as user-confirmed.

nodes.name: CareerProfile
nodes.description: Structured career profile with per-field provenance via inferred_fields.

nodes.name: _Infer
nodes.description: Collects which career fields were derived rather than user-stated.

nodes.name: _infer_role_family
nodes.description: Keyword-driven role-family inference from a title.

nodes.name: _infer_leadership_direction
nodes.description: Keyword-driven leadership direction inference from a title.

nodes.name: _latest_title
nodes.description: Most recent job title from the profile experience list.

nodes.name: _explicit_or
nodes.description: Return explicit value when present, else record field as inferred and use default/derive.

nodes.name: derive_career_profile
nodes.description: Deterministically build CareerProfile from profile.yaml; inferred fields never promote to VERIFIED.

nodes.name: job_agent/job_agent/career/reconcile.py
nodes.description: CV evidence derivation + reconciliation into existing evidence. Line-by-line fact extraction yields DOCUMENTED evidence; reconciliation is three-valued (exact / new / conflict), never auto-promotes or auto-resolves conflicts.

nodes.name: ReconciliationConflict
nodes.description: Explicit, never-auto-resolved conflict between an existing claim and a document claim sharing a structured key.

nodes.name: ReconcileResult
nodes.description: Deterministic, idempotent reconciliation output (evidence, new/kept ids, matches, conflicts).

nodes.name: _normalize
nodes.description: NFKC + casefold + whitespace collapse.

nodes.name: _structured_key
nodes.description: Best-effort (company, role_title) extraction from a factual line; None for non-experience lines.

nodes.name: _is_fact_line
nodes.description: True when a line is a usable factual line (not header junk or repeat).

nodes.name: _is_just_heading_repetition
nodes.description: True when a line merely echoes the section heading.

nodes.name: _extract_fact_lines
nodes.description: Yield bounded (claim, section, position, heading) triples, skipping non-fact/duplicate lines.

nodes.name: candidate_evidence_from_document
nodes.description: Derive deterministic, attributed DOCUMENTED-level evidence candidates from a CareerDocument.

nodes.name: _index_by_normalized
nodes.description: Index existing evidence by normalized fact.

nodes.name: _index_by_key
nodes.description: Index existing evidence by structured (company, role) key.

nodes.name: reconcile_document
nodes.description: Reconcile document-derived candidates against existing evidence: exact keep, new insert, conflict record. Idempotent, never promotes/demotes.
